name: Partitioned Distance Map (PDM) Acceleration
aliases: Accelerating Transfer Function Update for Distance Map based Volume Rendering
Direct Volume Rendering with Partitioned Distance Maps (PDM) based Empty Space Skipping
definition: A direct volume rendering technique using ray-casting that accelerates empty space skipping (ESS) by subdividing the volume intensity range into partitions. This creates partitioned distance maps (PDMs) which allow for faster updates of the distance map when the transfer function changes, maintaining high frame rates during frequent TF updates.
summary: Partitioned Distance Map Acceleration speeds up volume rendering by precomputing distance maps for intensity partitions, allowing fast transfer function updates by merging only relevant maps instead of recomputing the global distance transform.
